title: The Watering Hole
text: Every beast of the plains comes to drink at one pool at dusk: lions beside antelope, wolves beside deer. For an hour, they keep a truce. The water is pink in the sunset. No one has ever seen what happens when the hour is up.

options.label: Drink with the beasts, and keep the truce as they do.

outcomes.text: The beasts let you be. You have never felt so watched or so safe.
Something does not keep the truce.

options.label: The sharpest eye watches which beasts come, to learn what roams ahead.

outcomes.text: You learn what hunts the road ahead.

options.label: Break the truce while they drink. They will never be easier prey.

outcomes.text: Easy kills, at first, and the plains remember.
